title: Scheduler Liveness
description: Query strings below are plain-English-adjacent pseudo-SQL, not copy-paste-ready syntax for any specific Grafana datasource plugin — no real backend/datasource is wired up in this build. Two independent, real liveness signals: (1) kind:"run" records with run_kind = "audit" in ~/.claude/metrics/*.jsonl, written by audit_run.sh's _emit_run_record every time the repo-audit launchd job runs a package audit (Phase 2) — recency of the newest such record is this scheduler's heartbeat. (2) obs_ship.py's own health signal: run_once()/main() returns and prints a JSON object with a "reason" field (one of "ok", "tracer-unavailable", "all-spans-dropped", "export-failed") on every invocation, added by Phase 2's final review specifically so a launchd job's log carries a liveness/health signal beyond a bare exit code. This dashboard feeds a future Alert 1 to be defined in Task 3 of this same phase; it only visualizes the raw recency/reason signals here, it does not itself alert.

panels.title: Time since last audit run
panels.description: Source: kind:"run" records where run_kind = "audit" (audit_run.sh, Phase 2). Age of the most recent ts_end.

targets.query: SELECT now() - max(ts_end) AS age FROM runs WHERE run_kind = 'audit'

panels.title: Recent audit runs
panels.description: Source: kind:"run" records where run_kind = "audit". Fields: ts_start, ts_end, outcome, stop_reason, task_id.

targets.query: SELECT ts_start, ts_end, outcome, stop_reason, task_id FROM runs WHERE run_kind = 'audit' ORDER BY ts_start DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: obs_ship.py's own reason log
panels.description: Source: the "reason" field of obs_ship.py's run_once() result (ok / tracer-unavailable / all-spans-dropped / export-failed), printed as one JSON line to stdout on every invocation and captured in the obs-ship launchd job's own log file (Phase 2's final review added this field for exactly this liveness purpose).

targets.query: SELECT ts, reason, exported, count FROM obs_ship_log ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50
